method: Visual inspection of 627 frames sampled every five seconds across all eight files; additional shot-change candidates found by roughly half-second decoding samples and visually inspected; targeted one-second sequences inspected. This is systematic sampling, not a claim of uninterrupted normal-speed viewing or exhaustive original-film authentication.
conclusion: No authenticated moving apparition recovered in this pass. This does not establish that no original footage was ever made or survives elsewhere.
transcript_limits: Local faster-whisper base transcripts are unverified finding aids. English has recognisable transcription errors. Arabic is especially unreliable; radio_1_ar failed quality review. Empty output for app_story and mrcls does not prove absence of speech.

videos.title: Egyptian documentary
videos.visual_assessment: Church exterior/interior, Bishop Gregorios, clergy and crowds. The night roof segment around 00:30–00:40 shows the architecture; no identifiable moving Marian figure established. Original production date/reel custody unresolved.

videos.title: Pope Shenouda III narration
videos.visual_assessment: Newspaper and church-image montage. No identifiable motion sequence of the apparition established.

videos.title: From the Heart of the Event / radio interview
videos.visual_assessment: Later church-produced compilation, with 2008 credits, historical audio, newspaper scans, photographs, and moving images of clergy/crowds. The opening text attributes the historical recordings to Egyptian radio in 1968. This is not an original television master or proof that its images accompanied the original audio.

videos.title: U.S. television film
videos.visual_assessment: Interviews, photographs, illustrations and dramatic reenactments. At about 02:04–02:07 an illustrated figure appears over a fixed church photograph; this is an apparent illustrative overlay, not authenticated 1968 motion footage. Around 04:35–06:00, staged bedroom/healing scenes must not be mistaken for original event recording.

videos.title: U.S. television program
videos.visual_assessment: Later interviews with Khairy Malek and physicist John Jackson, church scenes, newspaper images and pans/zooms across familiar still photographs. The English automated finding aid at about 00:59 explicitly introduces photographs. The filename does not link this later programme to the proposed 1968 Fox production.

videos.title: The Apparition Story
videos.visual_assessment: Edited slide presentation: Arabic text, photographs, paintings, color changes, fades and decorative animation. No original moving figure established.

videos.title: The Apparition Miracles
videos.visual_assessment: Edited presentation of healing claims, clippings, photographs, religious artwork and effects. No original moving figure established. This audit does not assess the healing claims.

videos.title: The Apparition and Miracles
videos.visual_assessment: Later interview compilation with archival photographs, illustrations, and pans/zooms. The bird images around 03:55–04:15 and luminous figures around 04:20–04:58 are presented as still-image sequences; no authenticated motion capture established.
